The recurring ping-modal-overlay bug from iter_2/3/4 STILL blocks in-app interactions on Radar/Nearby — carry-over, not new. Deprecated shadow* console warnings still present.

ui_bugs.issue: CARRY-OVER from iter_2/3/4: the incoming Ping modal (Modal component with testID=ping-modal) appears every ~15-30s after login and covers the entire screen. On Nearby tab it fully obscures the user rows and dfilter chip scroll area (still tappable via testID query, but visual + real-user taps are blocked). On Radar it covers the NEARBY NOW row. It also survives tab-change (still visible when switching Radar→Nearby→Profile) until user taps ping-dismiss. The modal itself works perfectly (ping-reason + ping-context both render with spec-correct content), but its persistence across routes is disruptive. Auto-dismiss on route change or lower z-index / render behind tab bar recommended.

issues: When ping modal is up, the two ScrollView chip rows (filter + dfilter) remain scrollable visually but partially covered — consider auto-dismiss so user can access filters.

react_native_issues.issue: CARRY-OVER: Expo Web console emits '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' repeated on every render. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (shadow.card / shadow.md styles) used across cards and modals.

rca_of_issue: No new bugs found in iter_5 Vibe Details feature — all backend endpoints and frontend testIDs behave per spec. The one ongoing UI friction (ping modal overlay) is a design-persistence issue carried from iter_2/3/4: PingModal (React Native Modal component with animationType=slide) is owned by the tab-layout root and stays visible across route pushes because dismiss is only wired to the ping-dismiss button + view-profile flow. Fix: add useEffect on route/pathname in the ping owner that calls setPing(null) on route change, OR conditionally render only on the Radar route.
